State: round 1 (3c182c8) is verified: pnpm test 6 files 55 passed, typecheck clean, files only under packages/explorer. Reviewer verdict: no blocking defects; fix these.

Coordinator decisions (architecture §3.2 will say this):
- NFR-3: the bot replies within 2 s. So DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500 (still overridable via timeoutMs).
- After a timeout, network error or server_error (5xx), start a 30 s cooldown (new option failureCooldownMs, default 30000). During any cooldown, lookups that need the network return unavailable without fetching, with the reason of the failure that started the cooldown (rate_limited for 429). 1. client.ts:178/171: cache.get throwing makes lookup throw synchronously; cache.set throwing rejects a good result. Fix: lookup always returns a Promise; a get failure is a cache miss; a set failure is ignored (the fetched result is still returned). Test with a cache whose get and set throw.
2. client.ts:29 + cooldown: as decided above. Test: timeout, network and 5xx each suppress the next uncached lookup within 30 s and allow it after; bad_response does not.
3. client.ts:65: Retry-After that is not a non-negative integer must only be parsed as an HTTP-date if it looks like one (contains a letter); otherwise use the 60 s default. Test with "1.5" and "-5".
4. client.ts:124: cancel or drain the body of non-ok responses (await res.body?.cancel()).
5. client.ts:127: document on the fetch option that an injected fetch must honour AbortSignal for one-request-at-a-time to hold. No code change needed.
6. Tests: same-key waiters on a request that ends 429 or timeout all receive the unavailable result and can refetch after the cooldown; missing (not null) opening field parses to null; a corrupt cache row is treated as a miss.
